entities.name: FtsH protease
observations: The 706-aa query sequence has 82.3% identity and 93.3% query coverage to reviewed UniProt D4HA34, annotated as ATP-dependent zinc metalloprotease FtsH.
Sequence Pfam hits include AAA ATPase domains (PF00004; residues 203–335) and Peptidase_M41 (PF01434; residues 416–605), supporting ATP-dependent metalloprotease function.
Strong-homology annotation describes processive proteolysis of cytoplasmic and membrane proteins and quality control of integral membrane proteins.
Reference homolog is annotated to the cell membrane as a multipass protein with its catalytic machinery on the cytoplasmic side; localization of the query is inferred by homology.

entities.name: Protein quality control
observations: FtsH homolog annotations associate ATP-dependent proteolysis with protein catabolism and quality control of integral membrane proteins.
